name: multigender-hebrew-text-designer
description: MultiGender Hebrew Text Designer - A modern text-to-image generator for Hebrew typography

scripts.deploy:staging: wrangler pages deploy src --project-name staging-amba --config wrangler.staging.toml
scripts.deploy:production: wrangler pages deploy src --project-name noamba --config wrangler.production.toml
scripts.deploy:staging:ci: wrangler pages deploy src --project-name staging-amba --config wrangler.staging.toml --compatibility-date 2025-01-15
scripts.deploy:production:ci: wrangler pages deploy src --project-name noamba --config wrangler.production.toml --compatibility-date 2025-01-15
scripts.deploy:check: echo 'Checking deployment configuration...' && wrangler pages project list
scripts.deploy:status: echo 'Checking deployment status...' && wrangler pages deployment list --project-name staging-amba && wrangler pages deployment list --project-name noamba
